title: roureopsis obliquifoliolata
intro: Roureopsis obliquifoliolata, commonly known as the African or Asian tree of life, is a plant species from the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its antibacterial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties.
